explanationMd: Bring x terms to one side and constants to the other: 5 − 2 = 2x + x. Thus 3 = 3x and x = 1. Both original sides then equal four.

distractorRationale.e: This reverses the sign when collecting terms.
distractorRationale.a: This adds rather than subtracts the constant two.
distractorRationale.b: The two sides would be five and two.
